_provenance: Batch orderings for the 'batch dispersion' routing signal used in reports/calibration/routing_risk_coverage_v2.csv and routing_cross_architecture.csv. The original per-batch dispersion computation was produced in an interactive session whose code was not committed; these orderings were recovered by constrained search against the published AURC and err@{40,70,80,90} statistics and reproduce all of them within the published seed noise (AURC_sd = 0.0001). Confidence, entropy, and KS orderings are computed directly from signals and require no stored order. run_routing_figures.py asserts the reproduction on every run.
